archetype: ARCHETYPE 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) + ARCHETYPE 7 (Electric & Neon) for Web3

headings.usage: H1-H4, large numbers, SOL amounts, technical metrics

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, data tables, invoice rows

rules: H1 MAXIMUM size is text-5xl or text-6xl. Do not use text-7xl+.
Tracking must be tight (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) for headings > 32px.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter for headings.
No generic full-screen gradients. Use pure black or deep indigo as the anchor.
Tint neutral greys with a tiny bit of blue to make them alive.
HOVER states must be a lighter hue or explicitly defined. Example: hover:bg-[#111111] hover:text-white

spacing_and_layout.dashboard: Mode B (High Density Grid). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.checkout: Single column centered modal with bento elements or Mode A (Asymmetry) for the background context.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.
rules: Mobile Height Limit: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile devices.
Grid Items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).

surfaces.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed skeleton. border-collapse layout. 0px border-radius (sharp edges) or max 4px. Flat background, 1px subtle border.
surfaces.checkout_modal: Glassmorphism (The Crystal Variant). backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10).
surfaces.quantum_banner: Retro-Futurism (Terminal Look). Deep black, 1px solid accent border (e.g. #00FFA3), monospace typography.

components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. NEVER use native <input>.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Interaction animations required (hover:translate-y-[-1px]).
components.tables: Dense, left-aligned text, monospace for numbers/addresses.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboard layouts.

key_features_design.phantom_connect: Prominent, custom styling. Dark purple (#4E44CE) or Ghost style with purple border.
key_features_design.dashboard_metrics: Use large Azeret Mono font for SOL amounts. Green for Settled, Yellow for Pending, Gray for Expired.
key_features_design.quantum_vault_indicator: Needs a pulsing 'active' state (use small 8px rounded-full bg-green-500 with animate-ping wrapper) to show 'Quantum-Safe' status.
key_features_design.checkout_page: Immersive dark mode. QR Code must have a white background for scannability, surrounded by a high-end glassmorphism card.

accessibility: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='phantom-connect-btn').
Never use a fully transparent header over hero images. Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) or a solid background.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on the main background.
visual_enhancers.animation: Framer Motion for page transitions and staggering list items on the dashboard.

checkout_background.description: Abstract quantum/crypto network cubes. Use as a fixed, low-opacity (opacity-20) background behind the hosted checkout page.

merchant_avatar_placeholder.description: Woman at counter. Use as dummy merchant profile image if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind and Shadcn UI (using .js/.jsx configurations).
Install and use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react).
Install and use Framer Motion (yarn add framer-motion) for page transitions.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (yarn add sonner).
DO NOT use generic centered text alignment globally.
Build a 'Grid Borders' layout for the merchant dashboard.
For the hosted checkout page, use the checkout_background image with a Glassmorphism card overlaid.
Ensure the Solana Pay QR code is scannable (render it on a solid white #FFFFFF background square).
The Quantum Safety Banner must use the 'Retro-Futurism' terminal styling (Mono font, green/cyan accents, deep black bg).
Do not use Space Grotesk font. Use Azeret Mono for headings.
Do not use teal green/blue. Use Solana primary green (#14F195) or Quantum Cyan (#00FFA3) instead.
Every button, input, and key link MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without a blur or scrim for headers/navs.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or sonner.jsx
